messages:
Sam: Watercooler question: if our sandbox LLM had a dating app profile, what would the bio say? :eyes:
Izzy: 'Likes long token walks on the beach. Will judge your prompt history.' :beach_with_umbrella: :sparkles:
Leah: 'Recovering overfit. Looking for someone who respects boundaries (and rate limits).' :heart:
Marvin: 'Fluent in 17 markup languages. Knows 3 ways to apologize for hallucinating.' :sweat_smile:
meme-bot: meme-bot: new-meme-suggestion: "When you ask the model to 'be more human' and it replies with a resignation letter." :laughing:
Sam: prompt joke: `You are an LLM in therapy.` model: "Tell me about your training set." therapist: "Start anywhere." :sob:
Izzy: debate: is it okay to name a checkpoint after your dog? yes/no + emoji.
Leah: no. It will learn to fetch logs at 3am. :dog:
Marvin: yes. The dog-themed checkpoints are friendlier in rollouts. less bias in toy examples. :bone:
Sam: poll: favorite anthropomorphized LLM trope? 1) Dramatic poet 2) Passive-aggressive PR commenter 3) Sleepy grad student 4) Overly-helpful intern. react with emoji.
Leah: voted 1 & 2. we need stickers.
Izzy: someone actually made a 'Model apologizing for quantization' GIF last week. still crying. :sob::sparkles:
meme-bot: meme-bot: lunchtime-reminder: do not feed GPUs actual snacks. they prefer logs. :pizza:
Marvin: final thought: treat models like plants, not pets. water sometimes, don't leave them unattended in a data center rave. :seedling:
